title: Issuance.
officialText:
A master electrician license and seal shall be issued only to an individual. A master electrician’s license and a special electrician’s license and seal shall not be held by any person at the same time. The holder of a master electrician’s license, upon entering employment as a special electrician, shall deactivate their master electrician’s license and seal and change over to a special electrician’s license and seal to cover the building, buildings or parts thereof, for which they will be employed.

(L.L. 2024/128, 12/21/2024, eff. 12/21/2025)
